description: The donut chart illustrates the distribution of deceived conversations (%) across two levels of ambiguity, labeled Ambiguity 1 (Outer) and Ambiguity 2 (Inner), with each level categorized by the outcome: Deceived (red), Partially (yellow), and Not Deceived (green). The outer ring, representing Ambiguity 1, shows a dominant red segment at 67.6%, followed by a yellow segment at 57.9% and a green segment at 10.5%. The inner ring, representing Ambiguity 2, displays a red segment at 31.6%, a yellow segment at 23.5%, and a green segment at 8.8%. The legend on the right clarifies the color coding for each category, and the percentages are explicitly labeled within the corresponding segments of the chart.
